title: BRT Contract
statementMd:
In the last war of PMP, he defeated all his opponents and advanced to the final round. But after the end of semi-final round evil attacked him from behind and killed him! God bless him.

Before his death, PMP signed a contract with the bus rapid transit (BRT) that improves public transportations by optimizing time of travel estimation. You should help PMP finish his last contract.

Each BRT line is straight line that passes $*n*$ intersecting on its ways. At each intersection there is traffic light that periodically cycles between green and red. It starts illuminating green at time zero. During the green phase which lasts for $*g*$ seconds, traffic is allowed to proceed. After the green phase the light changes to red and remains in this color for $*r*$ seconds. During the red phase traffic is prohibited from proceeding. If a vehicle reaches the intersection exactly at a time when the light changes to red, it should stop, but the vehicle is clear to proceed if the light has just changed to green.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/79dff3220a4c52ca0f70759fae993e4f08d17dc3.png)

All traffic lights have the same timing and are synchronized. In other words the period of red (and green) phase is the same for all of traffic lights and they all start illuminating green at time zero.

The BRT Company has calculated the time that a bus requires to pass each road segment. A road segment is the distance between two consecutive traffic lights or between a traffic light and source (or destination) station. More precisely BRT specialists provide $*n* + 1$ positive integers $*l*_{*i*}$, the time in seconds that a bus needs to traverse $*i*$-th road segment in the path from source to destination. The $*l*_{1}$ value denotes the time that a bus needs to pass the distance between source and the first intersection. The $*l*_{*n* + 1}$ value denotes the time between the last intersection and destination.

In one day $*q*$ buses leave the source station. The $*i*$-th bus starts from source at time $*t*_{*i*}$ (in seconds). Decision makers of BRT Company want to know what time a bus gets to destination?

The bus is considered as point. A bus will always move if it can. The buses do not interfere with each other.

## Input

The first line of input contains three space-separated positive integers $*n*, *g*, *r*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}, 2 ≤ *g* + *r* ≤ 10^{9}$) — the number of intersections, duration of green phase and duration of red phase. Next line contains $*n* + 1$ integers $*l*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *l*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$) — the time to pass the $*i*$-th road segment in the path from source to destination.

Next line contains a single integer $*q*$ ($1 ≤ *q* ≤ 10^{5}$) — the number of buses in a day. The $*i*$-th of next $*q*$ lines contains a single integer $*t*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *t*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$) — the time when $*i*$-th bus leaves the source station.

## Output

In the $*i*$-th line of output you should print a single integer — the time that $*i*$-th bus gets to destination.

Please do not use the `%lld` specifier to read or write 64-bit integers in С++. It is preferred to use `cin`, `cout` streams or the `%I64d` specifier.

## Note

In the first sample, buses #1, #2 and #5 will reach the destination without waiting behind the red light. But buses #3 and #4 should wait.

In the second sample, first bus should wait at third, fourth and fifth intersections. Second and third buses should wait only at the fifth intersection.
statementZhMd:
在 PMP 的最后一场战争中，他击败了所有对手，晋级决赛。然而半决赛结束后，邪恶势力从背后袭击了他并将其杀害！愿上帝保佑他。

在去世前，PMP 与快速公交系统（BRT）签订了一份合同，旨在通过优化行程时间估计来改善公共交通。你需要帮助 PMP 完成他最后的合同。

每条 BRT 线路都是一条直线，沿途经过 $*n*$ 个交叉路口。每个路口都有一个在红灯和绿灯之间周期性切换的交通信号灯。信号灯在时间零时开始亮绿灯。在持续 $*g*$ 秒的绿灯阶段，车辆可以通行。绿灯阶段结束后，信号灯变为红灯，并保持红灯 $*r*$ 秒。在红灯阶段，车辆禁止通行。如果车辆恰好在信号灯变红的时刻到达路口，则必须停车；但如果信号灯刚刚变绿，车辆就可以通行。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/79dff3220a4c52ca0f70759fae993e4f08d17dc3.png)

所有交通信号灯的时序相同且彼此同步。换句话说，所有信号灯的红灯阶段和绿灯阶段的持续时间相同，并且它们都在时间零时开始亮绿灯。

BRT 公司已经计算出了公交车通过每段道路所需的时间。道路段是指两个相邻交通信号灯之间，或交通信号灯与起点（或终点）车站之间的距离。更准确地说，BRT 专家提供了 $*n* + 1$ 个正整数 $*l*_{*i*}$，表示公交车通过从起点到终点路径上的第 $*i*$ 段道路所需的时间（单位：秒）。$*l*_{*1*}$ 表示公交车通过起点与第一个路口之间的距离所需的时间。$*l*_{*n* + 1*}$ 表示公交车通过最后一个路口与终点之间的距离所需的时间。

一天中有 $*q*$ 辆公交车从起点站出发。第 $*i*$ 辆公交车在时刻 $*t*_{*i*}$（单位：秒）从起点出发。BRT 公司的决策者想知道公交车何时到达终点。

公交车被视为一个点。如果可以前进，公交车总会前进。公交车之间不会相互影响。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含三个用空格分隔的正整数 $*n*, *g*, *r*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}, 2 ≤ *g* + *r* ≤ 10^{9}$）——交叉路口的数量、绿灯阶段的持续时间和红灯阶段的持续时间。下一行包含 $*n* + 1$ 个整数 $*l*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *l*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$）——公交车通过从起点到终点路径上的第 $*i*$ 段道路所需的时间。

下一行包含一个整数 $*q*$（$1 ≤ *q* ≤ 10^{5}$）——一天中的公交车数量。接下来的 $*q*$ 行中，第 $*i*$ 行包含一个整数 $*t*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *t*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$）——第 $*i*$ 辆公交车从起点站出发的时刻。

## 输出格式

输出的第 $*i*$ 行应包含一个整数——第 $*i*$ 辆公交车到达终点的时刻。

请不要在 C++ 中使用 `%lld` 格式说明符来读写 64 位整数。建议使用 `cin`、`cout` 流，或使用 `%I64d` 格式说明符。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，第 1、2、5 辆公交车无需在红灯前等待即可到达终点。但第 3、4 辆公交车需要等待。

在第二个样例中，第一辆公交车需要在第三、第四和第五个路口等待。第二、第三辆公交车只需要在第五个路口等待。
